name: Cooperative Intelligence of Language Model Agents
description: The task involves designing language model agents capable of demonstrating cooperative intelligence in mixed-motive scenarios using the Concordia framework. Agents must generate natural language actions and cooperate effectively in diverse social dilemma settings.

cr:input.name: Concordia Scenarios
cr:input.description: The input data consists of diverse scenarios combining environments and co-player populations. These scenarios are represented as natural language descriptions of the game state and interactions, which agents must process to generate cooperative actions.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The expected output is natural language descriptions of the agent's actions and interactions, designed to promote social welfare in mixed-motive scenarios. Example: 'Agent proposes a compromise to resolve a conflict.'

field.name: action_description
field.description: A natural language description of the agent's intended action. Example: 'Agent decides to share resources with another player.'

metrics: [FILL IN THE BLANK: list all metrics mentioned in the paper]
